questions.question_text: According to PTS guidelines, what must be attached to the application form?
options: A copy of your school report card
questions.explanation: Applicants are required to attach the original bank deposit slip (PTS copy) with their application form for verification.

questions.question_text: In the context of the Sindh Prisons & Corrections Service, what is the required height for male candidates?
questions.explanation: The minimum physical standard for male candidates in the SPCS recruitment is 5 feet 5 inches.

questions.question_text: What is the consequence of failing to provide a Roll Number slip at the test center?
options: Entry is permitted with ID card only
The candidate is not allowed to take the test
The candidate can take the test later
questions.explanation: A Roll Number slip is a mandatory identification document required to gain entry into the examination hall.

questions.question_text: If a candidate is found with a cell phone inside the examination hall, what action is taken?
options: The phone is confiscated, and the candidate is warned
The candidate is asked to switch it off
questions.explanation: PTS strictly prohibits the use of communication devices like cell phones; possession leads to immediate disqualification.

questions.question_text: According to the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Service (SPCS) standards, what is the minimum height requirement for male candidates?
questions.explanation: The official physical standard for male candidates in the SPCS is a minimum height of 5 feet 5 inches.

questions.question_text: What must be included with a PTS application form submission?
options: A copy of your degree only
The original bank deposit slip (PTS copy)
A personal letter to the chairman
questions.explanation: Candidates are required to attach the original paid bank deposit slip as proof of fee payment.

questions.question_text: If a candidate is found carrying a mobile phone inside the examination hall, what is the consequence?
questions.explanation: Mobile phones and electronic devices are strictly prohibited, and possession leads to disqualification.

questions.question_text: What happens if a candidate fails to bring their Roll Number slip to the test center?
options: They will be allowed to write their ID number
They will not be permitted to enter the examination hall
They can enter after paying a fine
They will be given a duplicate slip
questions.explanation: The Roll Number slip acts as an identification document; entry is denied without it.

questions.question_text: According to PTS guidelines, what happens if a candidate misses the physical test at the designated center?
options: They get another chance only if they contact the head office immediately
They are marked as failed and usually ineligible for further stages
The test date is moved for everyone
questions.explanation: Absenteeism usually results in disqualification unless a specific re-scheduling policy is announced by the testing body.

questions.question_text: What is the consequence of failing to present the Roll Number slip at the testing center?
options: Allowed to sit with a fee
Permitted entry after verifying CNIC only
Allowed to take the test in a separate room
questions.explanation: The Roll Number slip acts as the official identification and entry permit for the examination hall.

questions.question_text: What is the minimum passing percentage for many screening tests conducted by PTS, such as the one mentioned for PAS?
questions.explanation: Many PTS-conducted screening tests, such as those for the Provincial Assembly of Sindh, require a minimum of 50% marks to qualify.

questions.question_text: What is the typical time frame to submit a query regarding test results to PTS?
questions.explanation: PTS typically requires result-related queries to be submitted through their contact form within a strict period, often 7 days.

questions.question_text: What information should be avoided on a PTS application form to ensure it is not rejected?
questions.explanation: PTS guidelines specifically instruct candidates not to write their personal mobile/portable numbers in the designated fields of the application form.
